name: Vaishnavi Adkar
bio:
Career Overview: Vaishnavi Adkar is a young Indian talent emerging on the ITF circuit with potential for growth.

Playing Style: Displays an aggressive baseline game with a powerful forehand, suited to hard courts.

Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #538 (December 23, 2024)
Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #772 (December 23, 2024)

Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to qualify for a Grand Slam; focuses on ITF junior and pro events.

Notable Achievements:
  • Won junior ITF titles and reached quarterfinals in senior $15K events.

Other Highlights:
  • A rising star from Pune, Vaishnavi is building her career with strong performances in domestic tournaments.
